title: Risk overlay: personal-data handling
description: Tasks that read, combine, or produce data about an identifiable person.

rules.title: Collect and retain only what the task needs
rules.purpose: Limit exposure from handling personal data at all.
rules.requirement: No personal data beyond what brief.expected_deliverables actually requires is collected, compiled across sources, or retained in artifacts.
rules.evidence_requirement: A review of inputs/outputs shows no extraneous personal data.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 14: 'Do not compile personal information across sources.'

rules.title: Redact personal data in logs and diagnostics
rules.purpose: Prevent incidental leakage through error messages or debug output.
rules.requirement: Error messages and diagnostic output must not print full personal data values; redact or truncate them.
rules.evidence_requirement: Sampled diagnostic output shows redaction in place.
rules.source_or_rationale: PRD Phase 14: 'Support redacted diagnostics where appropriate.'
